name: Short Attention Span
body:
You have little patience, causing you to have difficulty concentrating on repetitive tasks.

Prerequisite: None

Effect: -2 on all skill checks made to retry an action that you previously failed. This is cumulative granting a -2 on each failed attempt. You cannot take 20 on any skill check.
